AMP skips5/199/1903;one closed attempt,no failure/restart and no skips after1903.

Final is1.938% above best and exceeds1% threshold0.0874159714. Recent qualifying points are broken by2400-2700 and2900-3000;stable_step remains null. Both J577 seeds unstable by the frozen rule. Train loss falls from about0.04130 at2000 to0.03736 at3000 while validation fluctuates and ends worse. Late-loss-down/val-up flag true:compatible with mild overfitting/selection drift,not proof of a causal mechanism or explosive numerical failure.

interpretation: The second seed weakens the first-seed claim that577 improves J boundary F1 over500. Both stopping models lose boundary F1,especially seed112;mean selected-best F1 is not clearly different from B0. Best J outperforms R on AbsRel/band in the two matched seeds but has no clear AbsRel advantage over L. Wait for seed114 before full group conclusions.
